raw_translation: Ingiza HTTPS URL umma na kuwasilisha mara moja. ombi hutuma hakuna vidakuzi au mwongozo, haifuati redirects, na hukoma baada ya sekunde nane.
source: Enter a public HTTPS URL and submit once. The request sends no cookies or referrer, does not follow redirects, and stops after eight seconds.
translation: Ingiza HTTPS URL umma na kuwasilisha mara moja. ombi hutuma hakuna vidakuzi au mwongozo, haifuati redirects, na hukoma baada ya sekunde nane.
